context_requirements: Expression of PPARG, PPARD, or RXRA
Presence of PPAR-responsive transcriptional program (e.g., adipocyte/lipid metabolism genes)
Functional PPAR ligand-binding domain and coactivator recruitment
Cell lines with low PPAR expression or dependence may show minimal response
falsifiers: No change in expression of PPAR target genes (e.g., PDK4, FABP4, ANGPTL4) at 6 or 24 h in any cell line
Strong upregulation of PPAR target genes, which would suggest agonist rather than antagonist activity
No difference in response between cell lines with high vs. low PPAR expression
Transcriptional changes that are indistinguishable from generic stress responses without PPAR-specific signature
